users_deletion_due_idx.name: users_deletion_due_idx
users_deletion_due_idx.where: "users"."deletion_scheduled_for" is not null and "users"."erased_at" is null

community_gallery_items_source.name: community_gallery_items_source
community_gallery_items_source.value: ("community_gallery_items"."kind" = 'image' and "community_gallery_items"."storage_key" is not null and "community_gallery_items"."embed_url" is null) or ("community_gallery_items"."kind" = 'video_embed' and "community_gallery_items"."embed_url" is not null and "community_gallery_items"."storage_key" is null)

posts_scheduled_idx.name: posts_scheduled_idx
posts_scheduled_idx.where: "posts"."scheduled_at" is not null and "posts"."deleted_at" is null

posts_scheduled_due_idx.name: posts_scheduled_due_idx
posts_scheduled_due_idx.where: "posts"."scheduled_at" is not null and "posts"."deleted_at" is null

comped_memberships_expiry_idx.name: comped_memberships_expiry_idx
comped_memberships_expiry_idx.where: "comped_memberships"."ended_at" is null and "comped_memberships"."expires_at" is not null

comped_memberships_read.name: comped_memberships_read
comped_memberships_read.using: "comped_memberships"."community_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.community_id', true), '')::uuid and ("comped_memberships"."user_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid or coalesce(current_setting('app.payments_manager', true), '') = 'on')

fee_ledger_entries_sign.name: fee_ledger_entries_sign
fee_ledger_entries_sign.value: ("fee_ledger_entries"."kind" = 'fee_refunded' and "fee_ledger_entries"."computed_fee_minor" <= 0 and coalesce("fee_ledger_entries"."provider_fee_minor", 0) <= 0) or ("fee_ledger_entries"."kind" in ('fee_accrued', 'fee_collected') and "fee_ledger_entries"."computed_fee_minor" >= 0 and coalesce("fee_ledger_entries"."provider_fee_minor", 0) >= 0) or "fee_ledger_entries"."kind" in ('adjustment', 'invoice_settled')

payment_connections_own_keys_secret.name: payment_connections_own_keys_secret
payment_connections_own_keys_secret.value: "payment_connections"."provider" <> 'stripe_own_keys' or "payment_connections"."status" = 'disconnected' or ("payment_connections"."encrypted_secret" is not null and "payment_connections"."webhook_secret_encrypted" is not null)

payment_customers_read.name: payment_customers_read
payment_customers_read.using: "payment_customers"."community_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.community_id', true), '')::uuid and ("payment_customers"."user_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid or coalesce(current_setting('app.payments_manager', true), '') = 'on')

subscriptions_read.name: subscriptions_read
subscriptions_read.using: "subscriptions"."community_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.community_id', true), '')::uuid and ("subscriptions"."user_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid or coalesce(current_setting('app.payments_manager', true), '') = 'on')

reviews_author_or_anonymized.name: reviews_author_or_anonymized
reviews_author_or_anonymized.value: "reviews"."author_id" is not null or "reviews"."anonymized_at" is not null
